column4: Bypass package + doWipePersistProvisionedData from Fleet: reset in 13 min, fleetd reinstalled itself and the host came back as the same Fleet host 25 at the region screen with no prompt, MDM re-enrolled (mdm_enrolled 00:39:05), lab1 and its data gone, package kept.
Lab fault: the reset ran with only virtio-gpu, which the reset environment cannot draw on; it sat idle for 10 min, and a power cycle mid-reset left Windows unbootable. Rerun as C-2r.

No-bypass package + doWipePersistProvisionedData: host came back as the same Fleet host 27 in 13 min with no IdP sign-in and MDM re-enrolled; Fleet keeps the previous end user eua-user-1 attributed (repurposing gap).
